research_question: Do immutable public Epicure ingredient embeddings rank held-out human-observed substitutions above plausible alternatives?

external_dataset.name: Recipe1MSubs
external_dataset.label_source: ingredient substitutions extracted from user comments on Recipe1M recipes

train.use: identify directed source-target pairs previously observed in the substitution benchmark

test.use: all outcome estimation and hypothesis testing

external_dataset.redistribution: Raw Recipe1MSubs files are not redistributed; the builder downloads hash-pinned files from the official Meta host and publishes aggregates only.

mapping.rule: exact string equality between Recipe1MSubs canonical tokens and the 1790-entry public Epicure vocabulary
exclusions: source or target absent from the public Epicure vocabulary
duplicate directed source-target pair after exact mapping

candidate_universes.full_vocabulary: all public Epicure vocabulary entries except the source ingredient
candidate_universes.within_target_food_group: the observed target and every public Epicure ingredient with the same pre-existing food_group tag, excluding the source; require at least 20 candidates

scoring_rule: cosine similarity between the source and candidate ingredient vectors; no Recipe1MSubs label is used to fit or tune a checkpoint

primary_estimand.name: equal-source mean within-food-group rank percentile
primary_estimand.definition: For each unique directed mapped test pair, rank the observed target among the within-target-food-group candidates with average ranks for ties and map best to 1 and worst to 0. Average target percentiles within source ingredient, then average equally across source ingredients.
primary_estimand.hypotheses: one one-sided test per public checkpoint that the estimand exceeds 0.5
primary_estimand.multiplicity: Holm correction across the three checkpoint hypotheses at familywise alpha 0.05

secondary_estimands: equal-source within-food-group rank percentile restricted to directed test pairs absent from the Recipe1MSubs training split

reporting.required_sensitivity: repeat the primary estimand on mapped directed test pairs absent from the Recipe1MSubs training split
reporting.failed_primary_outcome: Report the estimate and uncertainty unchanged; do not replace the endpoint or mapping after seeing scores.

claim_boundary: This is label-independent convergent validation of substitution similarity for the three public Epicure checkpoints. Recipe1MSubs recipes derive from Recipe1M, which is upstream of part of Epicure's recipe corpus, so it is not corpus-independent validation. It does not validate the unrecovered primary runtime, the pairing or constraint reward components, human taste preference, safety, nutrition, or cooked-food outcomes.
